tasks.name: Enterprise Architecture & Monorepo Setup
tasks.description: Migrate to a TurboRepo monorepo structure. Implement Feature-Sliced Design (FSD), strict ESLint/Prettier rules, and setup scalable API boundary patterns.

tasks.name: Advanced Database & Distributed Caching
tasks.description: Setup connection pooling with Prisma/Drizzle. Integrate Redis for distributed caching of high-traffic queries and rate-limiting. Implement database sharding strategies.

tasks.name: Auth, RBAC & Enterprise Security
tasks.description: Implement Clerk or NextAuth with Enterprise SSO. Setup Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Mod, Hunter), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and strict Rate Limiting.

tasks.name: Elasticsearch & Semantic Vector Search
tasks.description: Deploy an Elasticsearch cluster for fuzzy text querying. Integrate a Vector Database (e.g., Pinecone/Milvus) for AI-driven semantic search based on game descriptions.

tasks.name: Global CDN & Automated Media Pipeline
tasks.description: Architect a resilient media pipeline. Integrate Cloudflare/AWS CloudFront. Automatically compress, resize, and convert user uploads to WebP/AVIF formats.

tasks.name: Real-time Community Infrastructure
tasks.description: Deploy WebSockets/Pusher for real-time capabilities. Implement live typing indicators, instant reply updates, online presence, and real-time notification feeds.

tasks.name: AI-Powered Moderation & Auto-Tagging
tasks.description: Integrate Gemini Vision API for automated NSFW image detection and text toxicity filtering. Build AI auto-tagging pipelines for incoming posts to reduce manual categorization.

tasks.name: Advanced SEO & Internationalization (i18n)
tasks.description: Implement Programmatic SEO. Generate dynamic XML sitemaps, JSON-LD structured data schema (SoftwareApplication/DiscussionForumPosting), and integrate multi-language support.

tasks.name: 3D Immersive Engine & WebGL Optimization
tasks.description: Enhance React Three Fiber scenes. Implement lazy loading for 3D assets, Level of Detail (LOD) optimization, WebGL shaders, and 2D fallbacks for low-end mobile devices.

tasks.name: High-End Motion & Interaction Architecture
tasks.description: Deploy complex framer-motion orchestration. Create physics-based page transitions, scroll-linked parallax effects, and smooth layout animations for dynamic community feeds.

tasks.name: Enterprise Telemetry & Observability
tasks.description: Integrate Sentry for distributed error tracking, PostHog for product analytics, and Datadog/NewRelic for backend infrastructure monitoring and Web Vitals tracking.

tasks.name: CI/CD, E2E Testing & IaC
tasks.description: Establish zero-downtime deployment pipelines. Write comprehensive Playwright E2E tests and Jest unit tests. Manage infrastructure via Terraform or Pulumi.
